title: Pullback along a morphism of schemes preserves constructible sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the pullback of a constructible sheaf of sets, of abelian groups or of Lambda-modules under an arbitrary morphism of schemes is again constructible, Lambda being Noetherian (statement lines 11807-11813). The proof is a complete reduction chain: locality of constructibility reduces to X and Y affine (proof lines 11815-11817); the characterization of constructible sheaves on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme by finite constructible partitions reduces the assertion to naming such a partition of X (proof lines 11818-11821); and the author produces it as the pullback of a partition of Y adapted to the given sheaf, invoking the compatibility of pullback with locally constant sheaves (proof lines 11822-11824). The non-formal content is the choice of the partition and the reduction steps. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with every input named.
